batchFiles.purpose: Swing-based GUI for PrimeFactors: calculator + integer factorization interface
batchFiles.description: GUI extends javax.swing.JFrame providing a complete Swing interface combining an RPN calculator (Deque stack) with integer factorization. Supports arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, remainder), 2^x/10^x, stack management, and composite factorization via ECM/SIQS. Includes Möbius, Euler totient, sum-of-divisors, and four-squares representation.

#BlueJ class context comment0.target=CalculatorImpl comment0.text= \ A\ model\ for\ an\ RPN\ calculator\ using\ the \ {@link\ java.math.BigInteger}\ class. \ @author\ Rod\ Howell \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ (howell@cis.ksu.edu) comment1.params=v comment1.target=CalculatorImpl(calculator.CalculatorUI) comment1.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ CalculatorImpl\ using\ the\ given\ user\ interface \ and\ base\ 10. comment2.params=v\ b comment2.target=CalculatorImpl(calculator.CalculatorUI,\ int) comment2.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ CalculatorImpl\ using\ the\ given\ user\ interface\ and\ base. comment3.params=op\ input comment3.target=void\ doOperation(calculator.Operation,\ java.lang.String) comment3.text= \ Performs\ the\ given\ operation.\ \ If\ input\ is\ non-null,\ it \ is\ treated\ as\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack.\ \ If\ input\ is\ ""\ or\ "-",\ it\ is \ interpreted\ as\ "0".\ \ Operands\ are\ taken\ from\ the\ top \ of\ the\ stack\ so\ that\ the\ top\ element\ is\ the\ last\ operand.\ \ The\ result \ (if\ any)\ is\ pushed\ onto\ the\ stack.\ \ When\ the\ operation\ is\ complete, \ the\ element\ that\ then\ resides\ at\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack\ (if\ any)\ is \ reported\ to\ the\ user\ interface.\ \ If\ an\ exception\ or\ error\ is\ thrown, \ the\ stack\ will\ be\ restored\ to\ its\ original\ contents,\ if\ possible. \

\ The\ following\ classes\ of\ operations\ are\ supported\: \

    \
  • \ {@link\ Push}\ -\ If\ input\ is\ null,\ a\ copy\ of\ the\ top\ of\ the\ \ \ \ \ \ \ stack\ is\ pushed.\ \ Otherwise,\ input\ is\ simply\ accepted\ as \ \ \ \ \ \ the\ new\ top\ of\ the\ stack.\ \ Unrecognized\ subclasses\ of \ \ \ \ \ \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.Operation}\ are\ treated\ as\ Push. \
  • \ {@link\ Pop}\ -\ Removes\ the\ top\ from\ the\ stack. \
  • \ {@link\ ClearStack}\ -\ Empties\ the\ stack. \
  • \ {@link\ RotateUp}\ -\ Moves\ the\ element\ at\ the\ bottom\ of\ the\ stack\ to\ \ \ \ \ \ \ the\ top. \
  • \ {@link\ RotateDown}\ -\ Moves\ the\ element\ at\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack\ to\ the \ \ \ \ \ \ bottom. \
  • \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.ConvertBase}\ -\ Converts\ the\ top\ of\ \ \ \ \ \ \ the\ stack\ to\ the\ base\ specified\ by\ \ \ \ \ \ \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.ConvertBase\#getBase()\ op.getBase()}. \ \ \ \ \ \ If\ the\ stack\ is\ empty,\ simply\ reports\ the\ new\ base\ to\ the\ user \ \ \ \ \ \ interface. \
  • \ {@link\ EDU.ksu.cis.calculator.EncodedOperation}\ -\ Performs\ the\ \ \ \ \ \ \ operation\ specified\ by\ the\ given\ subclass\ of\ EncodedOperation. \
\ @throws\ EmptyDequeException\ \ If\ the\ operation\ requires\ more\ operands \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ than\ are\ present\ on\ the\ stack. \ @throws\ to\ its\ original\ contents. \ @throws\ Exception\ \ If\ the\ given\ operation\ throws\ an\ Exception. comment6.params=op\ noNewInput comment6.target=void\ doStackOperation(calculator.Operation,\ Other\ subclasses\ of\ {@link\ Operation}\ are\ treated \ as\ Push. \ @param\ \ op\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ The\ operation\ to\ perform. \ @param\ \ noNewInput\ \ true\ iff\ no\ new\ input\ has\ #BlueJ class context comment0.target=DefaultUI comment0.text= \ The\ default\ user\ interface.\ \ This\ UI\ is\ appropriate\ for\ an\ RPN \ calculator\ supporting\ integer\ operations.\ \ The\ first\ argument\ to\ the\ single \ constructor\ gives\ the\ name\ of\ the\ package\ containing\ the\ classes\ that \ implement\ the\ model\ of\ the\ calcultator.\ \ One\ of\ these\ classes\ must \ be\ named\ CalculatorImpl\ and\ implement\ the\ interface \ {@link\ Calculator}.\ \ Furthermore,\ the\ CalculatorImpl\ class \ must\ contain\ a\ 2-argument\ constructor\ whose\ first\ argument\ is\ of\ type \ {@link\ CalculatorUI}\ and\ whose\ second\ argument\ is\ of\ type\ int. \ Other\ classes\ in\ that\ package\ which\ this \ class\ will\ attempt\ to\ instantiate\ include\: \
    \
  • \ ClearStack \
  • \ RotateUp \
  • \ RotateDown \
  • \ Remainder \
  • \ Power \
  • \ TwoToPower \
  • \ TenToPower \
  • \ Divide \
  • \ Multiply \
  • \ Subtract \
  • \ Add \
  • \ ChangeSigns \
  • \ Pop \
  • \ Push \
\ In\ order\ for\ these\ classes\ to\ be\ used,\ they\ must\ have\ a\ visible \ default\ constructor\ and\ implement\ the\ interface\ {@link\ Operation}. \ If\ any\ of\ these\ classes\ are\ missing\ or\ cannot\ be\ constructed,\ their \ corresponding\ buttons\ will\ be\ diabled. \

\ This\ UI\ supports\ any\ radix\ 2-36\ and\ allows\ conversion\ between\ them. \ Buttons\ are\ provided\ for\ the\ digits\ 0-9,\ but\ any\ digit\ valid\ for\ the \ current\ radix\ may\ be\ entered\ directly\ from\ the\ keyboard\ (see \ {@link\ java.lang.Integer\#toString(int,\ int)}).\ \ Keyboard\ equivalents\ are \ not\ provided\ for\ the\ operations. \ Menus\ are\ provided\ for\ editing\ (cut,\ copy,\ paste,\ select\ all)\ and \ changing\ whether\ the\ bases\ are\ "sticky";\ i.e.,\ if\ the\ current\ radix \ has\ changed\ since\ a\ value\ was\ pushed\ onto\ the\ stack\ and\ the\ bases\ are \ sticky,\ then\ if\ that\ value\ is\ moved\ to\ the\ top\ of\ the\ stack,\ it\ is \ displayed\ in\ the\ current\ base.\ \ Otherwise,\ it\ is\ displayed\ in\ the \ base\ in\ which\ it\ was\ originally\ entered\ or\ computed.\ \ The\ model \ is\ responsible\ for\ implementing\ this\ behavior\ by\ accepting\ a \ {@link\ java.lang.Boolean}\ as\ the\ first\ argument\ to\ \ {@link\ Calculator\#changeSettings(Object,\ String)}. \ The\ Home\ and\ End\ keys\ move\ the\ text\ caret\ to\ the\ beginning\ and\ end, \ respectively,\ of\ the\ display. \ @author\ Rod\ Howell \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ (howell@cis.ksu.edu) comment1.params=modelLoc\ parent comment1.target=DefaultUI(java.lang.String,\ javax.swing.JFrame) comment1.text= \ Constructs\ a\ new\ user\ interface. \ @param\ modelLoc\ \ The\ name\ of\ the\ package\ containing\ the\ calculator \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ model.\ \ The\ name\ must\ be\ terminated\ by\ a\ period. \ @param\ parent\ \ \ \ The\ applet\ on\ which\
